props.heading: We capture the moments that become your story
props.sub: Wedding photography, cinematography and album design — crafted for couples who believe every detail matters. Based in Bengaluru, available across India and abroad.

props.label: Our Story
props.heading: Crafting visual stories since 2014
props.body:
Aura Weddings & Events was founded on a simple belief: the best wedding photographs are the ones that feel like real life, not a photoshoot.

We are a team of ten photographers, cinematographers and editors who work across India and abroad. Every wedding is handled by a lead creative who meets the couple before the big day, understands what matters to them, and builds a shot list around real moments — not a template.

We do not outsource editing, and we do not deliver photos you will have to wait months for. Standard delivery is four to six weeks; same-day preview edits are included in our Platinum and Elite packages.

Our work has been published in WedMeGood, Brides Today and The Wedding Vow, and we have shot at over 200 venues across 12 countries.

pillars.title: Cinematic Craft
pillars.text: Every frame is composed with intent — light, composition and emotion, not just a fired shutter.

pillars.title: Storytelling First
pillars.text: We do not stage what did not happen. The best images are the ones you forget are being taken.

pillars.title: One Creative, One Couple
pillars.text: Your lead photographer is present from the engagement call through to delivery — no handoffs.

pillars.title: Published & Recognised
pillars.text: Featured in WedMeGood, Brides Today and The Wedding Vow. Over 500 weddings delivered.

props.label: Photography Packages
props.heading: Choose your collection
props.sub: All packages include edited digital images with printing rights, an online gallery and a personal consultation. Prices are all-inclusive with no hidden fees.

items.title: Gold Collection
items.desc: Classic wedding coverage with a single photographer, digital handover and a premium printed album. Perfect for intimate weddings and smaller guest lists.
items.body:
The Gold Collection is our most popular choice for weddings with up to 150 guests. A single lead photographer covers the full day — from the bride's preparation through to the post-dinner celebrations — capturing 800 to 1000 edited images.

What is included:
• One lead photographer for up to 10 hours
• 800–1000 professionally edited images in colour and black-and-white
• Private online gallery for sharing with family
• Printing rights for personal use
• One premium 10x10 inch printed album with 30 spreads
• One pre-wedding consultation call

Delivery: Edited gallery within 6 weeks. A preview of 50 images within 48 hours.

The Gold Collection covers all standard ceremonies. Additional family events (reception, mehendi, sangeet) on the same property are included at no extra cost. Travel within Bengaluru city limits is included; destination weddings are quoted separately.

productInfo.label: Delivery
productInfo.value: Gallery in 6 weeks, preview in 48 hours

items.title: Platinum Collection
items.desc: Two photographers, cinematic highlight film, premium leather album and a same-day preview edit. Our most popular choice for grand weddings.
items.body:
The Platinum Collection is built for larger weddings with 150 to 400 guests. Two photographers ensure no moment is missed — while one covers the main ceremony, the second captures family reactions, decor details and candid moments across the venue.

What is included:
• Two photographers for up to 12 hours
• 1200–1800 professionally edited images
• Cinematic highlight film (4–6 minutes)
• Same-day preview edit (15 images within hours of the ceremony)
• Private online gallery with sharing and download
• One premium 12x12 leather-bound album with 40 spreads
• Two pre-wedding consultation sessions

Delivery: Full gallery within 5 weeks. Highlight film within 8 weeks.

The Platinum Collection covers all ceremonies including mehendi, sangeet, wedding and reception across multiple venues on the same day. Travel within Karnataka is included; inter-state and international travel is charged at actuals.

items.title: Elite Collection
items.desc: Full weekend coverage, drone cinematography, crystal album and a dedicated engagement shoot. For couples who want every moment documented without compromise.
items.body:
The Elite Collection is our most comprehensive offering, designed for destination weddings, multi-day celebrations and couples who want every frame to be a work of art.

Two photographers and a cinematographer travel with you across the full wedding weekend. A drone adds sweeping aerial perspectives of the venue, procession and group shots.

What is included:
• Two photographers + one cinematographer for the full weekend (up to 3 days)
• Drone aerial coverage (4K)
• 2000+ edited images
• Full cinematic wedding film (6–8 minutes) + one-minute Instagram cut
• Dedicated engagement shoot (half day, any location within 100 km)
• Same-day preview edits
• Premium 14x14 crystal-face album with 50 spreads
• Three pre-wedding consultation sessions including venue walkthrough

Delivery: Full gallery within 4 weeks. Highlight film within 6 weeks. Engagement shoot gallery within 2 weeks of shoot.

Travel and accommodation for the team are included for locations within India. International destination weddings require flights and accommodation for the team, quoted separately at the time of booking.

items.q: How do I book you for my wedding?
items.a: Start by filling in the contact form below or messaging us on WhatsApp. We will set up a free consultation call (video or in-person) to understand your wedding, show you full galleries from similar weddings, and walk you through the packages. A 25% advance confirms your date.

items.q: Do you travel for destination weddings?
items.a: Yes — we shoot across India and internationally. Travel and accommodation within India are included in the Elite package and quoted separately for Gold and Platinum. International travel is charged at actuals for all packages. We handle our own travel arrangements so you do not have to coordinate.

items.q: When will we receive our photos?
items.a: Gold Collection galleries are delivered within 6 weeks, Platinum within 5 weeks, and Elite within 4 weeks. A preview of 30–50 images is sent within 48 hours of the wedding. Highlight films follow 2–3 weeks after the gallery. These timelines are commitments, not estimates — we plan our workflow around them.

items.q: Can we meet our photographer before the wedding?
items.a: Absolutely. Every package includes at least one pre-wedding consultation. Platinum and Elite include two and three sessions respectively, one of which can be a venue walkthrough. You will know exactly who is shooting your wedding, and they will know exactly what matters to you.

items.q: What happens if you cancel on us?
items.a: It has never happened, but if it does, we refund the full amount and help you find a replacement photographer of equal or better quality within your budget. The industry standard is to refund only the advance; we believe that is not enough.
Yes. After the 25% advance, the remaining balance can be split into two or three instalments. The final payment is due on or before the wedding day. We do not charge interest on instalments.

items.q: Can we print photos from our online gallery?
items.a: Yes — all images are delivered with full printing rights for personal use. You can print them at any lab, make photo books, and share them freely on social media. We only ask that you do not sell the images or remove our watermark.

props.sub: Tell us about your wedding — date, venue, style and the moments that matter most to you. We will send a personalised quote and availability within 24 hours.

notes:
CONTENT MODEL: Built as a wedding photography studio (Aura Weddings & Events) serving the Indian wedding market. This is the most feature-rich industry template with 14 sections, using video in the hero, masonry gallery for portfolio, and the products section for photography packages with Duration × Album pricing.

VIDEO: The hero uses videoUrl (YouTube/Vimeo link) — the first industry template to use this feature. Set to a placeholder YouTube URL that the studio should replace with their actual wedding highlight reel. The image field serves as the fallback when the video does not play.

PRODUCTS: Three photography packages (Gold/Platinum/Elite) use the full products manifest with attributes (Coverage × Album type), per-combination pricing via variants, full body copy, productInfo tables, slugs for individual product pages, and enableOrder for cart/booking. Stock levels are set realistically: some combinations are stock 0 to demonstrate sold-out states. This is only the second template (after travel) to use the products section, and the first to use it with 2-attribute variants.

GALLERY: Uses the masonry variant instead of the basic grid-3 used by most other templates — better suited for a photography portfolio. 12 images with descriptive alt text and lightbox enabled.

BLOG: Three real-wedding blog posts with cover images, dates, excerpts and link text. Written as journal-style features about specific weddings.

TEAM: Four team members (Ananya, Vikram, Neha, Arjun) with first-name-only and no photographs, following the salon.json and gym.json convention of not pairing stock photos with made-up names. The studio should replace with actual team photos.

STATS: Uses only verifiable-sounding numbers (500+ weddings, 12+ years, 200+ venues, 98% 5-star). No invented awards.

PRICING: Photography package prices are set at realistic Indian premium wedding photography rates as of mid-2026. Gold at ₹49,999 is the entry point for intimate weddings; Platinum at ₹89,999 targets the mainstream premium market; Elite at ₹1,49,999 positions as the full-service luxury option. Prices should be verified against the studio's actual rates before going live.

IMAGES: All photos are hosted Unsplash URLs using the ?auto=format&fit=crop&w=...&q=80 pattern. Must be replaced with the studio's own portfolio before going live. The hero image is a fallback for when the video does not play.

BUSINESS INFO: Address is set to Indiranagar, Bengaluru — a well-known locality. Social links point to Instagram and YouTube, which are the primary platforms for visual wedding work (vs Facebook or Twitter). The studio should replace all business info with actual details.

TERMS: Footer includes a termsBody with standard wedding photography contract terms (advance, cancellation, image usage, travel). The studio must replace with its own terms reviewed by a legal advisor before going live.
